name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-powered presentation builder that produces polished decks without generic, low-effort output.
problem: Creating professional presentations is time-consuming, and most AI tools produce visually bland, templated results that require heavy manual cleanup. Chronicle 2.0 aims to close the gap between AI speed and design quality, letting teams build compelling decks faster without sacrificing visual integrity.
useCases: Building investor pitch decks with a polished, non-generic aesthetic
Creating internal business reports and strategy presentations
Designing client-facing proposals and project overviews
Rapidly iterating on presentation drafts for marketing or sales teams
